structural_caveats: Sherlock Holmes character is largely public domain (US: pre-1928 stories; UK: copyright expired 1980). A 'fake' classifier keyed on 'is this Sherlock Holmes branded merch?' will produce false positives because anyone may legally produce Sherlock-Holmes-themed merchandise.

This brand is NOT the trademark holder; downstream legal claims of 'counterfeit' should be limited to copying of THIS BRAND's specific product photography, distinctive phrases (Just Deduce It), and visual assets.
12 SKUs use vendor='Printify' (a print-on-demand fulfillment platform) — same back-end could be used by anyone, so SKU-level uniqueness is weak for those items.
